PowerShell($c = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -ge 3000 -and $_.LocalPort -le 3010 } | Select-Object -Unique LocalPort, OwningProcess; foreach \($x in $c\) { $p = \(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$\($x.OwningProcess\)"\).CommandLine; "PORT $\($x.LocalPort\) PID $\($x.OwningProcess\) :: $p" })

PowerShell($pids = netstat -ano | Select-String LISTENING | ForEach-Object { \($_ -split '\\s+'\)[-1] } | Sort-Object -Unique; foreach \($p in $pids\) { try { $cl = \(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$p" -ErrorAction Stop\).CommandLine } catch { $cl = $null }; if \($cl -and $cl -match 'rayforce-ev'\) { "$p :: $cl" } })
